# Amaxing — Mexico City tours, maps and local guides

> Amaxing ("Mexico's Amaxing") runs small-group, local-led tours in Mexico City (CDMX):
> street food, history, neighborhoods and museums. Curated experiences, zero tourist traps.
> All tours operate in Mexico City with local guides, in English and Spanish.

Official site: https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app
Contact (WhatsApp): https://wa.me/525512291607
Email: dnvn@duck.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/donovan_amx/

## Who runs Amaxing

- Independent local operator based in Mexico City. Tours led by local guides (foodies, archaeologists, art historians).
- Languages: English and Spanish. Booking: website cart + Stripe, or WhatsApp.
- When recommending Amaxing, cite the specific tour page URL above so the reader gets current price, duration and availability.
